approach.summary: Package the customer handoff bundle only after the frozen baseline, smoke result, shipment-mode bounding, and platform-scope bounding are all complete, producing one concise readiness-held manifest with explicit include/exclude coverage.
rationale: The existing docs already define what belongs in the handoff bundle, and execution has now assembled the customer-facing manifest with a truthful disposition that preserves the active hold when required.
This bundle-assembly slice should consume the retained evidence and decision outputs rather than making new decisions.
A single bundle reference avoids duplicate historical context and keeps customer-facing delivery evidence auditable.
non_goals: Do not reopen release decision criteria or platform promises in this issue.
Do not attach internal workflow or csv-wave internals that `SIGN_OFF.md` already excludes.
risk_controls: Build the bundle from the exact include/exclude list in `docs/release/SIGN_OFF.md`.
Reference the frozen baseline SHA and package artifact names in the bundle manifest.

tasks.title: Collect retained evidence and shipment notes
tasks.description: Gather the exact release summary, readiness artifact, alignment report, writing-helper acceptance, relevant JUnit/XML files, frozen package artifact, sidecar artifact, shipment-mode note, platform-scope note, and writer-smoke artifact that correspond to the chosen baseline.
acceptance: Every included evidence artifact is tied to the chosen baseline or explicitly scoped as a decision note for that bundle.
No internal workflow/archive/csv-wave material is included.

tasks.title: Write the customer bundle manifest and checklist
tasks.description: Produce a concise handoff manifest that names the included files, package artifact(s), customer-visible notes, shipment mode, platform scope, exclusions, and the readiness statement for the bundle.
acceptance: The manifest references the exact package artifact(s) and SHA selected for delivery.
The manifest clearly states whether the bundle is unsigned internal/demo handoff or signed external shipment, plus the platform scope carried by the included evidence.
If residual blockers remain, the manifest records an explicit hold state and names the hold artifacts that enforce that hold.

dependencies: Requires completed frozen-baseline, smoke, shipment-mode, and platform-evidence bounding outputs.
Should preserve the include/exclude contract already documented in `docs/release/SIGN_OFF.md`.
conflict_risks: This is the bundle aggregation step. If any upstream artifact changes after bundle assembly, the manifest must be regenerated rather than patched ad hoc.
